text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume TCG: Twinkle Stars!
On sale now!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"My 'UR Tokai Teio: Beyond the Horizon'
comes with a shiny holographic finish!
Make sure to grab one!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Classic Teio, the sparkly horse girl.
Even her cards are sparkling like crazy~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Say, does having a sparkly card
actually mean it's strong?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that depend on card rarity?
Teio-san's is a UR, so it should be pretty strong.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so since ours are Common cards,
their strength is kinda underwhelming, huh...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
――Weak just because it's Common?
In a TCG, you can't jump to such conclusions so easily.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ruler-san.
...Meaning, my card is actually playable?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Starting from square one, I see.
Then allow me to teach you the true depth of TCGs!

I had heard about a tournament for the newly released
Umamusume TCG and dropped by to watch――
choice_data_list: Nature, Ruler. Are you two spectating too?
Nature, Ruler. Are you two spectating too?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm here to show Nature
just how deep TCGs can get.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at that table over there.
Whose cards do you see lined up?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
! M-Me...?! Wait, Ikuno and Tannhauser are there too...!
It's practically all Common cards. Why――

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Rule-wise, you can only play low-cost cards
in the early game. That's where Commons shine!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Nature's card has well-balanced stats and consistent
solid value. It naturally covers medium and long distances,
and holding its own at mile distance is huge!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
When combined with Skill cards――
Oh, perfect timing. Let's go watch that table!

text_block_list.name: TCG Tournament Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, Mejiro McQueen versus Nice Nature!
The race drawn from the deck is...
"Hanshin, Turf 2000m, Rain, Firm — The Osaka Hai"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It has arrived! A firm turf under rain counts as "Adversity," which cannot be countered in advance. And the activation condition for Nature's unique skill is "Adversity"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: If he plays the skill card "Pure Guts" to double the effect of Adversity, along with "Distant Back" to counter URs right here—!

text_block_list.name: TCG Tournament Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the skill card effects, Nice Nature closes the gap on McQueen in an instant!
The winner is—

text_block_list.name: TCG Tournament Commentator
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature! Player Gesocorone advances to the finals!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoaa...!? F-For real? My card beat an Ultra Rare McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Many URs actually struggle against "Adversity." If you construct a deck centered around "Adversity," even a Common Nature card can dominate the entire board!

text_block_list.name: TCG Tournament Commentator
text_block_list.text: —Now, let's hear from the victorious Player Gesocorone on their thoughts heading into the finals!

text_block_list.name: Player Gesocorone
text_block_list.text: Yes, I really wanted to win using the Nice Nature card, so I'm thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Player Gesocorone
text_block_list.text: I'm a huge fan of the horse girl Nice Nature! Since she's such a down-to-earth, steady hard worker, she doesn't always stand out, but—

text_block_list.name: Player Gesocorone
text_block_list.text: Her running showed me endless possibilities. It proved to me that with hard work, anyone can stand shoulder-to-shoulder even with geniuses...!

text_block_list.name: Player Gesocorone
text_block_list.text: She is my star of hope—Nice Nature. With this deck, I want to put up a fight worthy of her!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Me... a star of... hope...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Formulating tactics just to help your favorite card shine. That, too, is a valid way to battle in TCGs.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, that actually sounds super cool...
choice_data_list: I can't wait for the finals with the Nature deck!
I'm really looking forward to the Nature deck in the finals!

text_block_list.name: TCG Tournament Commentator
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature crosses the finish line in first place! The champion of the Umamusume TCG Tournament is Player Gesocorone—!

text_block_list.name: TCG Tournament Commentator
text_block_list.text: And presenting the award at the ceremony is none other than Nice Nature-san herself, who happened to drop by to watch!

text_block_list.name: Player Gesocorone
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaat!? N-Nature-san!? Um, um, um... I'm a huuuge fan of yours!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thanks a lot. Honestly, having someone like me as your main card—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No... not "someone like me." Thank you for showing everyone such an incredible battle using my card.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —I can't let myself get outdone by the Nature card, either!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aww, they lost... That Teio card in the opponent's deck was seriously strong.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Though they lost, this tournament sufficiently demonstrated the utility of the Nature card. We might see an increase in players maining it from now on.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh... really? Heh heh, look at you go, Nature card.
